name: Boxes
description: Boxes in the prompt for a model that takes them (FLUX 3 Image): where an element goes, which one stays, moves or is removed, which reference layer is placed where, words to render. A canvas tool (X) that draws, moves and resizes them, a panel in the Generate pane, Selection → box, Copy rows, and the commands boxes.add / set / remove / list / from_selection / clear for scripts and agents. The boxes are saved with the document and sent with every run of a recipe that takes them.
author: Scumble
